description: Hero section background color is wrong. Live uses a light sand/sage band; clone renders a dark saturated olive. Verified with hard evidence: live mobile full-page capture (undimmed region) samples rgb(222,216,190) ~#DED8BE; clone samples rgb(94,80,8) #5E5008, which traces to `--clr-9: rgb(94, 80, 8)` at src/app/globals.css:116 (hero uses bg-clr-9 in src/app/cold-pressed-juices/page.tsx). Desktop overlay-corrected math gives the same live value (footer-black check proves the popup overlay is neutral black, so channel ratios are trustworthy: live B/R=0.86 near-neutral vs clone B/R=0.085 saturated). Affects BOTH viewports; on mobile the black 'Cold-Pressed Juices' heading sits on dark olive instead of light sand, flipping the intended contrast.
live: hero band bg rgb(222,216,190) light sand; black heading text on light background
clone: hero band bg rgb(94,80,8) dark olive (--clr-9 in globals.css:116); black heading on dark background
